verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Kong AI Gateway logs request/response payloads, token usage, and costs (docs-10), and offers DLP/PII removal (docs-20) and semantic caching (docs-11), but none of the evidence describes configurable data retention periods or deletion/purge controls for logs, caches, or audit trails. Missing for 10: explicit retention policy settings, log/cache deletion or expiry controls, data subject deletion workflow.
